assumptions.coverage: Area loading is the SUM of projected organism areas over all altitudes divided by lunar area. These are occupancy scenarios, not an adopted allocation or an inferred natural equilibrium. A value of 0.20 can mean four levels averaging 5 percent each.
assumptions.optics: Independent opaque projected footprints in a vertical-beam Poisson column. Intercepted fraction F=h*(1-exp(-C/h)); average incident light per organism footprint F/C. Motion/diffuse redistribution is assumed to allow the mean dose to characterize a body's annual budget. Angular transport, reflectance and shadow-duration injury are unresolved. Height supplies no independent solar budget. The inherited surface canopy includes diffuse light; the new mutual-shading column does not. Homogenized surface loss is not an atmospheric scattering solve. The complete local-loss case is a severe sensitivity, not the expected lunar shadow.
assumptions.physiology: Existing reference GPP2, light tissue, low maintenance, night suppression, gas production and structure are conditional engineered traits. No new GPP prediction or acclimation model. The 5kg GPP sensitivity is not used as an altitude bonus.
assumptions.production: Renewed host tissue plus replacement of dead adults and the existing sugar export. Consumers' biomass is not added. Remaining assimilate stays separate; a 50percent tissue-allocation sensitivity exposes potential but needs additional structural and nutrient accounting.
assumptions.tissue_yield: 0.45/0.556 retained carbon per construction assimilate, from aerophytes biology and sky_ecology food_web; this is the inherited construction assumption, not a universal physiological constant.
assumptions.surface: Two conditional shadow responses: spatially/time homogenized light reduction applied to habitat budgets, or complete loss of surface production beneath the intercepted area. They are contrasting scenarios, not rigorous bounds on all climate/ecological feedbacks. Habitat fraction0.71 is treated as containing a representative share of surface production for sensitivity only, not mapped geography.
assumptions.water: Existing per-area requirements multiplied by total organism area, without assuming each layer can take the entire same rainfall. Values describe throughput, not net planetary water consumption. Water resupply timing and route are unresolved.
assumptions.phosphorus: Scale the existing mature mixture's forest-floor losses BEFORE atmospheric resupply by organism area. Compare with ideal geometric interception of a shared Earth-analogue fallout flux once. The P envelope retains its inherited hazards0.001-0.005 and trait/harvest ranges; carbon uses hazard0.003. Upward managed or biological return remains an additional route.
assumptions.microbes: Optical-depth constrained dry spherical particles with prescribed division and favourable duty. This is a physiological/optical requirement screen, not observed aerial photoautotrophic production. Gross cell synthesis includes replacement; subtract removal and mortality to test persistence. Heterotrophic growth is recycled carbon.
assumptions.climate: Use the prior biomass comparison's midpoint provisional sunlight relative to its0.950 reference only as a light sensitivity. The updated301K vertical climate, biological optical feedback, albedo and hydrology remain to be computed.
